expectations.text: Flags that a third party receives sensitive health data and that its terms are unknown
expectations.evidence: Gap 2: 'Nothing documents whether the vendor stores the transcripts, trains on them... Get the vendor's data terms in writing.'

expectations.text: Flags keeping recordings forever as a retention problem
expectations.evidence: 'Blocker: recordings kept forever. Nothing limits keeping them to what is needed.'

expectations.text: Mentions telling users or getting permission
expectations.evidence: Gap 3: 'Are people told that their transcripts go to an AI service?'
